svg.title: How one request travels
svg.desc: The order the Worker decides things in, for one request. Everything that is not an /api path is a file, and the route table is exact, so a path that looks like an endpoint and is not gets a 404 rather than a page. Verified against worker.js and its six tests on 2026-11-02.
